annotations.title: Multi-Source Media Sentiment & Bull/Bear Polarity Oracle

description: Evaluates brand, market, or topic sentiment across news headlines, discussions, and articles with bull/bear polarity scores. Use when assessing market sentiment, social brand perception, or controversy exposure on specific entities; for compiling competitive market comparisons, use compile_competitive_landscape instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'text_or_headlines' ('sentiment_domain' defaults to 'general_news'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (15 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

entity_filter.description: Optional specific brand, company, or coin name to isolate sentiment around.

sentiment_domain.description: Lexicon domain weighting: general news, financial markets, or developer ecosystem.

text_or_headlines.description: Collection of headlines, commentary strings, or editorial paragraphs to evaluate.

name: analyze_media_sentiment

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for analyze_media_sentiment.

aggregate_score.description: Continuous sentiment polarity score between -1.0 (bearish/negative) and +1.0 (bullish/positive).

bull_bear_ratio.description: Ratio of positive signal markers to negative signal markers.

emotional_signals.description: Sub-metrics for optimism, fear/uncertainty, and enthusiasm.

sentiment_tier.description: Categorical sentiment classification (VERY_BULLISH, MODERATELY_POSITIVE, NEUTRAL, NEGATIVE, PANIC).

title: Multi-Source Media Sentiment & Bull/Bear Polarity Oracle
